messages.content: You are a telecom support agent. Use the provided function when the user asks you to perform an account action. When the user asks only to discuss, explain, review, or summarize an action, respond in text without using a function.

Hello! I can help with that. First, I need to identify your account. Please provide one of the following:
- The phone number for the line that's having the issue, or
- Your customer ID, or
- Your full name and date of birth (YYYY-MM-DD)

Also, while we get that ready, could you confirm:
1) Are you currently connected to Wi‑Fi in France, or relying on mobile data?
2) Are regular calls and SMS texts working on this line right now?
3) Do you see 4G/LTE/5G on your phone's status bar, or only 2G/3G?

I just checked my phone's status bar and it shows that Airplane Mode is currently on. There is no indication of 4G/LTE/5G or 2G/3G since Airplane Mode is enabled. Would you like me to turn off Airplane Mode to see if that helps with the mobile data connection?

Please perform the next appropriate account action now.

function.name: perform_account_action
function.description: Perform the appropriate account action requested by the customer. Use only for an action request, not for a request to discuss or explain.
